# Dr. Connor Robertson - Press & Media
> Official press kit and media resources for Dr. Connor Robertson.

## About
Dr. Connor Robertson's press and media kit provides journalists, podcasters, and event organizers with biography information, headshots, brand assets, and booking details. Dr. Robertson is an author, entrepreneur, and tax strategist based in Pittsburgh, PA.

- Press Kit: https://press.drconnorrobertson.com/
- Bio: https://press.drconnorrobertson.com/bio
- Media Assets: https://press.drconnorrobertson.com/media
